page.subtitleEmpty: Every piece you own, beautifully catalogued.
page.emptyBody: Photograph your first piece and the stylist will start building your combination table. Six to eight pieces unlock real outfits.

readiness.requiredNote: Top, bottom and shoes are required. Outerwear, a watch and accessories are optional; they add layers and finishing touches to outfits.
readiness.notReady: Confirm at least a top, a bottom and a pair of shoes — that's the minimum the stylist needs before it can weave an outfit. Outfits then build automatically as you add each piece.
readiness.pending: {count, plural, one {# piece still needs} other {# pieces still need}} outfits built. This usually happens on its own — tap to finish now.
readiness.ready: You're set — the stylist has woven outfits from your wardrobe. Head to Today for a recommendation.

upload.title: Add a piece
upload.descriptionMinor: Photograph the piece on its own: no one wearing it, and no name labels in view.
upload.description: One clear photo on a flat surface or hanger works best.
upload.kindLabel: What kind of piece is it?
upload.aboutPlaceholder: e.g. White pique polo, slim fit, from Lacoste
upload.aboutHint: Mentioning the material — pique, knit, merino — makes tagging far more accurate.
upload.aboutHintMinor: Describe the piece, not the child: no names, ages or school names.
upload.manualOn: You fill in colour, type and material; the photo is not sent to the AI.
upload.manualOff: The AI reads the photo and fills in the details for you to check.
upload.needPhoto: Add a photo of the piece first
upload.analyzeFailed: Uploaded, but the stylist couldn't read it — you can re-analyze from the item page.
